sentences.japanese: わずかながらお金を貯めている。
sentences.english: She has a little money put aside.

sentences.japanese: もっとお金を貯めたかったのだけれど。
sentences.english: I had hoped to save more money.

sentences.japanese: メアリーは日本に行くためにお金を貯めている。
sentences.english: Mary is setting by money to go to Japan.

sentences.japanese: マックは新型ムスタングが買いたいので、お金を貯めている。
sentences.english: Since Mac wants to buy a new Mustang, he is saving money.

sentences.japanese: まさかの時に備えてお金をいくらか貯えておくべきだ。
sentences.english: You should save some money against a rainy day.
